content.short: Statemind delivers Solidity and Vyper smart contract audits for top DeFi protocols.
content.description: Statemind provides Solidity and Vyper smart contract audits for leading DeFi protocols, including Lido, Yearn, Arrakis, and 1inch. The firm operates across Ethereum and other major networks, including Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, Moonbeam, Fantom, BNB Chain, and Multichain. OpenZeppelin has named Statemind among the top 10 blockchain hacking techniques, underscoring its security focus. To date, Statemind has helped save about $350 million in funds by preventing 0-day exploits, reflecting a track record of identifying critical vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.
